request.description: The attribute dictionary: every borrower fact the platform understands (questions, lender rules, imports and routing all refer to these keys). Optional filters: `status` (`active`, `inactive`), `subject` (`person`, `business`, `any`). Money is in paise, durations in months. Staff only. Reading needs attribute read access (ops lead, compliance, support); changes need attribute manage access (ops lead, super admin). Every change is audited, published as `attribute.changed` and clears the dictionary cache immediately.
